caption: The drawing features two blue glass vases set against a plain, off-white background. The larger vase is centrally positioned and dominates the composition. It is bulbous with a rounded body, narrow neck, and flared lip, and has vertical grooves running from the neck to the base, giving it a ribbed texture. The vase is rendered in shades of blue, with lighter and darker areas indicating highlights and shadows to suggest transparency and gloss. The second, smaller vase is located in the upper right quadrant of the image. This vase is slim and cylindrical with a slightly narrower neck and a similar blue coloration and reflective highlights. Both vases cast no visible shadows on the background, and the overall arrangement is simple with a focus on the forms and color of the glass objects.
title: Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
